title: GENERAL ENGLISH – LEVEL 03
overview: General English – Level 03 is a pre-intermediate English course designed for learners who can communicate in familiar situations and are ready to express ideas with greater fluency, accuracy, and independence. The course develops listening, speaking, reading, and writing through practical situations, structured language study, and interactive tasks. Learners expand their vocabulary, use a wider range of tenses and sentence structures, explain experiences and opinions, and communicate more confidently in social, travel, study, and routine workplace contexts.
audience: Learners who have completed General English – Level 02 or demonstrate comparable elementary English proficiency.
Adults and young professionals seeking greater confidence in everyday and workplace communication.
Students preparing to progress toward intermediate English study or future examination preparation.
Individuals who need to participate in longer conversations, understand practical texts, and write connected messages.
methodology: Communicative, learner-centered lessons combining guided language practice with authentic interaction.
Pair and group discussions, role plays, problem-solving activities, and situational dialogues.
Listening practice using everyday conversations, announcements, interviews, and short presentations.
Reading and writing workshops with model texts, drafting, peer review, and trainer feedback.
Pronunciation drills, vocabulary recycling, regular formative quizzes, and progress assessments.
competencies: More fluent participation in familiar social and professional conversations.
Accurate use of core pre-intermediate grammar and sentence patterns.
Understanding main ideas and important details in clear spoken and written English.
Writing coherent paragraphs, emails, descriptions, and short narratives.
Expressing preferences, plans, opinions, comparisons, and reasons with appropriate vocabulary.
Self-correction, communication repair, and independent language-learning strategies.
objectives: Describe experiences, routines, achievements, and future intentions using appropriate tenses.
Ask follow-up questions and sustain conversations on familiar topics.
Express opinions, make suggestions, agree or disagree politely, and explain reasons.
Understand the main points of clear speech and moderately extended everyday texts.
Read short articles, instructions, messages, and narratives for gist and specific information.
Write organized emails and connected paragraphs using basic linking expressions.
Apply modal verbs, comparatives, conditionals, and common verb patterns in context.
Improve intelligibility through stress, intonation, connected speech, and pronunciation practice.
